_comment: Follow-up to run 20261007-main for the two models whose shared-prompt score was mostly a coordinate-format failure. Same OpenRouter ids as config/models.json; each model gets a prompt identical to prompts/bbox_v1.txt except for the coordinate instruction, and is scored under that convention. 'prompt' is relative to repo/. Gemini: [y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max] normalized 0-1000 (Google's documented grounding format). Kimi: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] in pixels of the 1024x791 image, which is what it answered in all three main-run calls; this is inferred from its output, not taken from vendor documentation.
